theories.claim: Implementation identity drift during QA sharding may be missed, allowing evidence to be bound to a stale fingerprint
theories.basis: internal/sprint/qa.go:803-845 captures before/after targetIdentity via verify.go:349 targetIdentity and compares to qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint; targetIdentity hashes git HEAD, symlink targets, and file contents with escaping-symlink rejection; race between before/after and map revalidation could still publish stale synthesis
theories.verification_surface: internal/sprint/verify.go:349 targetIdentity, internal/sprint/qa.go:325 prepareQAAttempt and 242-248 validateCurrentQAMap, internal/sprint/qa_prompt.go:75 ApprovedQAChecks uses WorkingDirectory == target
theories.confirmation_condition: a retained QAShard records ImplementationBefore != ImplementationAfter or differs from qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint yet shard is marked QAPhaseCompleted and published via QAStore.Publish
theories.refutation_condition: every shard attempt records identical ImplementationBefore/After matching qaMap.ImplementationFingerprint and governed-input revalidation fails closed with QAErrorStaleInput on mismatch as in qa_test.go:221-257 and qa_prompt_test.go:165 TestTargetIdentityRejectsSymlinkEscapeAndRecordsContainedSymlink
theories.inconclusive_condition: target tree is not present or hashFile/stat fails due to I/O error, preventing deterministic identity capture without mutating workspace
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read verify.go targetIdentity, qa.go runOneQAShard identity checks, qa_map.go targetIdentity invocation; inspect symlink handling and hashBytes usage; request no shell or workspace write

theories.claim: Cumulative follow-up shard budget may be bypassed by chained synthesis invocations creating more than FollowUpShards total across attempts
theories.basis: internal/sprint/qa_synthesis.go:27 SynthesizeQAWithChallenges caps followCandidates to Budgets.FollowUpShards but each call recomputes from current shard set; internal/sprint/qa.go:389 pendingQASynthesisFollowUps and 615 finalizeQASynthesisFollowUps track retained FollowUp count with limit FollowUpShards en route to final ID; if hydrator not used, incremental chains could exceed cumulative budget
theories.verification_surface: internal/sprint/qa_synthesis.go:33 SynthesizeQAWithChallenges and 122-136 followUp generation, internal/sprint/qa.go:589 pendingQASynthesisFollowUps and 615 finalizeQASynthesisFollowUps, internal/sprint/qa_synthesis_test.go:117 TestQASynthesisFollowUpsUseOneCumulativeAttemptBudget
theories.confirmation_condition: retained shard set contains shard.Kind==follow_up count > Budgets.FollowUpShards or synthesis FollowUpShards length grows beyond budget across iterative pending loops
theories.refutation_condition: pendingQASynthesisFollowUps computes remaining = limit - followUpCount and terminates when remaining <=0, finalizeQASynthesisFollowUps rejects len>budget, and test caps chained pending to exactly remaining budget of 1 as in qa_synthesis_test.go:144-153
theories.inconclusive_condition: synthesis requires complete shard theories to compute follow-ups; without running shards, follow-up generation cannot be fully exercised
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: read qa_synthesis.go and qa.go pending/finalize logic, review qa_synthesis_test.go deterministic and cap tests; trace budget constants in qa_types.go:126 DefaultQABudgets/MaximumQABudgets; no execution or file write
